ask.text: Mind your head, little warrior — no, I'm teasing. I'm Brannoch. I keep this outpost fed and armed. A supply cart overturned on the roads and the bundles scattered. Three of them. I'd fetch them myself, but the Warden says the outpost needs me where she can see me.

accept.text: Good. They glow a little — Oddrin's idea, so nothing gets lost twice. Look along the roads east and north, and by the western woods.

reminder.text: Three bundles. Roads east, north, and the edge of the western woods.

return.text: All three! You've saved me a long talk with the Warden. Here — I cut this axe down for a human grip. It hits like a Burrok, if you can swing it.

after.text: Burrok carry the heavy things. That's not a complaint — it's a promise. If you ever need something lifted, broken, or held shut, find me.
